props.emptyText: No photos yet. Put pictures in this library's folders and scan it.

pages.title: Photos
pages.description: Every photo library together, newest first, then the albums in each.

pages.description: A photo library's albums on every app: the person's own and the shared ones, each opening its pictures. Opened with ?item=<library id>&name=<its name>.

props.emptyText: No albums yet. Albums are made in a browser or the desktop app.

pages.title: {title}
pages.description: One album's pictures on every app, newest added first, each opening as in its library. Opened with ?item=<album id>&name=<its name>.

props.emptyText: This album is empty, or holds nothing this profile may see.

presets.label: New photos in each library
presets.description: A row of large pictures for each photo library, newest first.

sources.label: Photo albums
sources.description: The albums a person sees in a photo library: their own and the shared ones, each with its cover and how many pictures they may see in it, opening the album.

sources.title: Albums

sources.label: An album's pictures
sources.description: The pictures in one album that the person may see, newest added first.

params.name: album
params.label: Album
params.help: The album's ID, $item on its page.

views.label: Photo timeline
views.description: A photo library as the web and desktop apps draw it: the timeline by month, albums, favourites, folders, the map and uploads. Other apps show what's inside it.

views.label: Photo map
views.description: The pictures of a photo library that say where they were taken, on a map, in the web and desktop apps. Other apps show what's inside it.

groups.title: The map
groups.footer: Without an online map, the photo map draws the world's outline from this server and asks no one for anything. With one, each person's browser asks the map's provider for the squares it shows, so the provider sees roughly where they are looking.

rows.label: Use an online map
rows.help: Off: only the outline, and nothing leaves this server.

rows.label: Online map address
rows.help: An https address of map squares with {z}, {x} and {y} in it, such as https://tile.example.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Use a provider whose terms allow it.

rows.label: Credit to show on the map
rows.help: The credit the provider asks for, as one line of plain text.
